defaultDescription.zh-CN: 坐落于惠斯勒主村核心门户位置，距Whistler Village Gondola仅约140米、下午可滑回酒店雪具厅门口，全部客房均为带独立厨房与壁炉的套房。
defaultDescription.en: Positioned at the gateway to Whistler Village just 140 m from the Whistler Village Gondola with ski-back convenience and all-suite accommodations featuring kitchens and fireplaces.
defaultDescription.zh-Hant: 坐落於惠斯勒主村核心門戶位置，距Whistler Village Gondola僅約140米、下午可滑回酒店雪具廳門口，全部客房均為帶獨立廚房與壁爐的套房。
